notes.title: Style update: Introducing eyewear and more hats
notes.notes:
New styles, faster loading!
The latest Magnecube update brings a whole new layer of customization and performance:

🕶️ Eyewear Arrives: Express yourself with bold, quirky, or mysterious glasses.
🎩 More Hats: Even more headwear options to suit your vibe.
⚡ Community Level Boost: We've significantly improved loading times for community-created levels, so you can jump into the action faster than ever.

Mix and match your new look, dive into fan-made challenges, and feel the difference!

notes.title: 🎉 New Achievements + Localization Update! 🌍
notes.notes:
We’ve just added even more achievements to Magnecube! Whether you're a casual collector or a hardcore completist, there's now more reason than ever to keep those magnets flying.

And that’s not all—achievements are no longer English-only. We've now localized them into multiple languages so players around the world can enjoy the chaos in their native tongue.

Ready to hunt them all? 🔥
